message.subject: New Employee Onboarded in Microsoft Entra ID - @{items('For_each_New_User')?['data']?['displayName']}

body.content:
Hello @{outputs('Compose')},

A new employee has been successfully onboarded to Microsoft Entra ID and has been assigned to you as their reporting manager.

Employee Information

AttributeValue
Employee ID (Paycom ID)@{items('For_each_New_User')?['data']?['urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User']?['employeeNumber']}
Employee Name@{items('For_each_New_User')?['data']?['displayName']}
Position Code@{items('For_each_New_User')?['data']?['title']}
User Principal Name (UPN)@{items('For_each_New_User')?['finalUPN']}
Email Address@{if(equals(items('For_each_New_User')?['data']?['urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:elcarwash:1.0:User']?['Persona'], 'Frontline'), 'Not applicable (Frontline worker)', items('For_each_New_User')?['finalUPN'])}
Temporary Password@{outputs('GenerateTempPassword')}

Action Required

Please coordinate with your team member and securely share the temporary password listed above.

For security purposes, the employee will be required to change their password upon first sign-in.

Employee Sign-In Instructions

  1. Navigate to https://myaccount.microsoft.com
  2. Sign in using UPN: @{items('For_each_New_User')?['finalUPN']}
  3. Enter the temporary password
  4. Change password when prompted
  5. Access assigned applications

Access Provisioning

Based on the employee's position code and birthright access policies, access to applicable downstream applications will be provisioned automatically.

If any employee information is incorrect or assistance is required, please contact the IAM Team.


Regards,
IAM Entra Automation Service
Identity & Access Management (IAM) Team

The account @{items('For_each_New_User')?['finalUPN']} (Employee ID @{items('For_each_New_User')?['data']?['externalId']}) was not found in Entra ID within 60 minutes of upload. No password was set and no manager email was sent. Please check the provisioning logs.
